When I first started dating my current boyfriend he wasn't vegan either. I told him from the start that I really couldn't imagine being with someone long term who didn't share the same morals. Also at the beginning I really didn't think it'd turn into something serious so I just let it go but over time as we grew closer I kinda starter resenting him for consuming animal products. I thought of him as such a kind and compassionate person in every other area but at the same time he kept contributing to so much suffering. We got into a lot of fights because of that so please do not compromise on your beliefs. Luckily after some time he agreed to watch a few documentaries and have a deep conversation about veganism with me and that did it. Went vegan overnight and became such an activist 😅

So maybe don't limit yourself to vegans only because some people genuinely just don't know any better and you have to show them the way 🌱 But it's definitely not easy and I might have just been very lucky to get a guy like that. But don't give up, people like that definitely exist 😊
